Successfully implemented the missing MultiSequentialEvaluator class to enable optional copying of logpdfs before running MCMC chains.

1. Added MultiSequentialEvaluator class to pints/_evaluation.py that evaluates a list of functions on corresponding input values
2. Updated pints/__init__.py to export MultiSequentialEvaluator making it available as pints.MultiSequentialEvaluator

The implementation passes the previously failing test (pints/tests/test_evaluators.py::TestEvaluators::test_multi_sequential) and maintains backward compatibility with all existing evaluator tests. This resolves the AttributeError that occurred when trying to use pints.MultiSequentialEvaluator and enables the requested functionality for MCMC controllers to use separate log_pdf objects per chain.

input.issue:
Optionally copy logpdfs before running mcmc
Currently, the MCMC controller calls `__call__` or `evaluateS1` on the same `log_pdf` object for all mcmc chains.

This causes problems for more complex LogPDF objects which have attributes which may be updated based on the parameters sent to the call method (in my case, the LogPDF object holds a grid of ODE solver time points which is updated adaptively as the chain moves through parameter space).

It's easy enough to fix by making one copy.deepcopy of the log_pdf for each chain, and adding an appropriate pints.Evaluator so each chain is just calling its own log_pdf object. @MichaelClerx let me know if this makes any sense as an optional argument to the MCMC controller !
